# LodgeHere

> Verified student accommodation across Nigerian campuses with zero agent fees, transparent upfront pricing, and mandatory in-person physical inspections.

LodgeHere connects tertiary students across Nigeria directly with verified landlords and caretakers, replacing exploitative roadside middlemen with accountable, transparent tenancy.

## Core Features
- **Zero Agent Fees**: 100% direct landlord rentals with no 10-20% agent commission or agreement extortion.
- **Physical In-Person Inspections**: Students schedule inspection dates and times before committing or transferring any rent.
- **Room-Level Accuracy**: Track exact room codes, private bathroom status, and current occupancy.
- **Itemized Pricing**: Total upfront move-in costs clearly stated (rent, caution deposit, service charge).
- **Landlord Verification**: Multi-tier vetting of host identity and property letting rights.

## Key Links & Endpoints
- [Explore Lodges](https://lodginghere.vercel.app/explore): Search and filter student lodges by campus, price, and amenities.
- [Campus Directory](https://lodginghere.vercel.app/universities): Browse accredited Nigerian universities (UNILAG, UI, OAU, UNN, UNIBEN, FUTA, and more).
- [How It Works & Verification Policy](https://lodginghere.vercel.app/how-it-works): Comprehensive guide on the 3 layers of listing verification and physical inspection rules.
- [Terms of Service](https://lodginghere.vercel.app/terms): Student and landlord accommodation rules and caution deposit guidelines.
- [Privacy Policy](https://lodginghere.vercel.app/privacy): Data protection practices compliant with NDPR.

## Universities Covered
- University of Lagos (UNILAG) - Akoka, Yaba, Lagos
- University of Ibadan (UI) - Agbowo, Bodija, Ibadan
- Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU) - Mayfair, Asherifa, Ile-Ife
- University of Nigeria Nsukka (UNN) - Nsukka, Enugu State
- University of Benin (UNIBEN) - Ugbowo, Ekosodin, Benin City
- Federal University of Technology Akure (FUTA) - South & West Gate, Akure
- University of Ilorin (UNILORIN) - Tanke, Fate, Ilorin
- Ahmadu Bello University (ABU) - Samaru, Zaria
- Lagos State University (LASU) - Ojo, Lagos
